description: The changes in the watched tools, oldest first, 100 per page. Pass the cursor of the last call in `depois` to get only what is new. The same changes reported by account email while each tool was watched (last 30 days when `depois` is omitted, up to 100 per page). Repeat with `depois` set to the prior `cursor` while `mais` is `true`, or keep polling the last cursor when nothing is new. `email: true` indicates the account also gets these changes by email.

depois.description: The `cursor` of the last response. Leave it out to read the last 30 days.
